blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解為何在 VHP 除汙前必須先完成清潔與消毒，並能說明「清潔驗證除汙」的概念。
blocks.en: Understand why cleaning and disinfection must be completed before VHP decontamination, and explain the concept that "cleaning validates decontamination."

blocks.zh: 比較隔離器常用的除汙劑（VHP、過氧乙酸、二氧化氯），了解各自的機制與 VHP 兩種產生方式（熱板蒸發 vs. 霧化）的差異。
blocks.en: Compare the decontamination agents commonly used in isolators (VHP, peracetic acid, chlorine dioxide), and understand their mechanisms and the difference between the two ways of generating VHP (flash vaporization vs. fogging).

blocks.zh: 解釋為何空腔隔離器的溫濕度 mapping 是除汙週期資格確認的先決條件，以及熱點/冷點如何影響殺孢子效果。
blocks.en: Explain why temperature and humidity mapping of the empty isolator is a prerequisite for decontamination cycle qualification, and how hot spots and cold spots affect sporicidal efficacy.

blocks.zh: 定義除汙週期開發時的「最差條件（worst-case）」邏輯，包括負載配置、材質特性與遮蔽表面的影響。
blocks.en: Define the "worst-case" logic used in decontamination cycle development, including the effects of load configuration, material properties and occluded surfaces.

blocks.zh: 將 Q7-1 至 Q7-4 的知識整合為一套隔離器除汙驗證策略，能在 CDMO 無菌灌裝現場實際應用。
blocks.en: Integrate the knowledge from Q7-1 to Q7-4 into a single isolator decontamination validation strategy that can be applied on the floor of a CDMO aseptic filling site.

blocks.zh: Q7-1  |  Cleaning & Disinfecting Isolator Interiors Prior to Decontamination Q7-1 | 去污前雔離器內部的清潔與消毒
blocks.en: Q7-1 | Cleaning & Disinfecting Isolator Interiors Prior to Decontamination

blocks.zh: 解說與思考 — 繁體中文
blocks.en: Commentary and Discussion

blocks.zh: 核心觀念：清潔不等於除汙
blocks.en: Core concept: cleaning is not decontamination

blocks.zh: 這是很多工程師容易混淆的地方。清潔（Cleaning）是移除殘留物和異物；消毒（Disinfection）是降低活菌數（bioburden）；除汙（Decontamination）才是真正的孢子殺滅步驟（通常靠 VHP）。三步驟必須依序完成，缺一不可。
blocks.en: This is where many engineers get confused. Cleaning removes residues and foreign matter; disinfection reduces the viable bioburden; decontamination is the actual spore-kill step (usually achieved with VHP). The three steps must be completed in sequence, and none can be skipped.

blocks.zh: 比喻：手術前的皮膚準備
blocks.en: Analogy: skin preparation before surgery

blocks.zh: 想像外科醫師消毒切口前，一定先清除傷口的汙垢與碎屑——你不會把碘酒噴在泥土上就算消毒完成。VHP 也一樣：殘留的藥物粉末或油脂會在孢子和 VHP 之間形成「保護盾」，讓除汙效果大打折扣。
blocks.en: Think of a surgeon preparing an incision site. Dirt and debris are always removed first; you would never spray iodine onto soil and call it disinfected. VHP works the same way: residual drug powder or grease forms a "protective shield" between the spores and the VHP, and decontamination efficacy drops sharply.

blocks.zh: 因此，「清潔驗證除汙」（cleaning validates decontamination）是這一章的核心邏輯——你的清潔程序要能確保 VHP 接觸到所有孢子，而不是接觸到殘留物的表面。
blocks.en: This is why "cleaning validates decontamination" is the core logic of this chapter: your cleaning procedure must ensure that VHP reaches every spore, not just the surface of a residue layer.

blocks.zh: 重點：Hold Time 的雙重管制
blocks.en: Key point: two-part hold time control

blocks.zh: PDA 要求消毒程序中必須定義兩個時間窗口：
blocks.en: PDA requires two time windows to be defined in the disinfection procedure:

blocks.zh: Hold time prior to disinfection：清潔結束 → 開始消毒的最長等待時間
blocks.en: Hold time prior to disinfection: the maximum waiting time from the end of cleaning to the start of disinfection

blocks.zh: Hold time after disinfection：消毒完成 → 開始 VHP 除汙的最長等待時間
blocks.en: Hold time after disinfection: the maximum waiting time from the end of disinfection to the start of VHP decontamination

blocks.zh: 這兩段時間若超過限制，bioburden 可能回升，讓消毒步驟失去意義。在 SOP 撰寫時，這兩個參數必須明確寫入並驗證。
blocks.en: If either time limit is exceeded, bioburden may rebound and the disinfection step loses its value. Both parameters must be written explicitly into the SOP and validated.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務提醒：多產品共用隔離器
blocks.en: CDMO practice reminder: multiproduct isolators

blocks.zh: 如果你的隔離器是 multiproduct（不同品項輪流使用），清潔程序必須針對「前一個產品的毒性與殘留風險」設計。毒性愈高的產品，清潔驗證標準愈嚴格。這直接關係到交叉汙染風險評估（cross-contamination risk assessment）的結果。
blocks.en: If your isolator is multiproduct (different products used in rotation), the cleaning procedure must be designed around the toxicity and residue risk of the previous product. The more toxic the product, the stricter the cleaning validation criteria. This feeds directly into the outcome of the cross-contamination risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 設計要點：隔離器內部材質
blocks.en: Design point: isolator interior materials

blocks.zh: PDA 列出的設計考量，說白了就是「容易清潔、不藏汙納垢」：
blocks.en: The design considerations PDA lists boil down to "easy to clean, nowhere for dirt to hide":

blocks.zh: 表面光滑無孔（smooth and nonporous）——粗糙表面藏孢子
blocks.en: Smooth and nonporous surfaces: rough surfaces harbor spores

blocks.zh: 不積液（drain properly）——積液是 bioburden 溫床
blocks.en: Drain properly: standing liquid is a breeding ground for bioburden

blocks.zh: 縫隙最小化——尤其靠近產品路徑的區域
blocks.en: Minimize crevices, especially close to the product path

blocks.zh: 如果設計本身有缺陷，再完美的清潔 SOP 也無法彌補。
blocks.en: If the design itself is flawed, even the best cleaning SOP cannot make up for it.

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Discussion exercise

blocks.zh: 你的隔離器如果今天 bioburden 監測結果超過已驗證除汙週期的 spore log reduction 上限，下一步應該怎麼做？（提示：PDA 原文已經給了答案——additional disinfection step。）
blocks.en: If today's bioburden monitoring result for your isolator exceeds the spore log reduction limit of the validated decontamination cycle, what should the next step be? (Hint: the PDA text already gives the answer: an additional disinfection step.)

blocks.zh: Q7-2  |  Current Options for Isolator Interior Decontamination Q7-2 | 雔離器內部去污的現有方法選項
blocks.en: Q7-2 | Current Options for Isolator Interior Decontamination

blocks.zh: 比喻：VHP 的「兩相平衡」是關鍵難點
blocks.en: Analogy: the "two-phase balance" of VHP is the key difficulty

blocks.zh: 想像浴室裡的水蒸氣：溫度高一點，鏡子不起霧；溫度低一點，整面鏡子都是水珠。VHP 也是如此——表面溫度決定「凝結量」，凝結量決定殺孢子效果。
blocks.en: Picture water vapor in a bathroom: a slightly higher temperature and the mirror stays clear; a slightly lower temperature and the whole mirror is covered in droplets. VHP behaves the same way: surface temperature determines the amount of condensation, and the amount of condensation determines sporicidal efficacy.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 PDA 說 VHP 除汙「幾乎不可能精確掌握某一時刻某一點的物理參數」——它是一個動態平衡的複雜過程，不是「噴一噴就好」的消毒。
blocks.en: This is why PDA says it is "nearly impossible" to know the exact physical parameters at a given point and moment during VHP decontamination. It is a complex, dynamic equilibrium process, not a case of "just spray it and it's disinfected."

blocks.zh: 熱板蒸發 vs. 霧化：兩種 VHP 產生方式
blocks.en: Flash vaporization vs. fogging: two ways to generate VHP

blocks.zh: 熱板蒸發（Flash Vaporization）：
blocks.en: Flash vaporization:

blocks.zh: 液態 H₂O₂ 注入熱板，瞬間汽化成乾燥高溫蒸氣
blocks.en: Liquid H₂O₂ is injected onto a hot plate and instantly vaporizes into a dry, high-temperature vapor

blocks.zh: 優點：蒸氣乾燥，均勻分布
blocks.en: Advantage: the vapor is dry and distributes evenly

blocks.zh: 風險：溫度不夠或注液過快 → 沸騰（非閃蒸）→ 效果差，甚至爆炸
blocks.en: Risk: if the temperature is too low or the liquid is injected too fast, it boils (rather than flash vaporizes), efficacy is poor and it can even explode

blocks.zh: 遠端產生器需防止管路中提前冷凝
blocks.en: A remote generator must prevent premature condensation in the piping

blocks.zh: 霧化（Fogging）：
blocks.en: Fogging:

blocks.zh: 不需加熱，靠超細噴霧（micron 級液滴）自然蒸發
blocks.en: No heating is needed; ultra-fine spray (micron-sized droplets) evaporates naturally

blocks.zh: Dry fog（<15 µm）：液滴不沉降，以蒸氣相吸附為主，曝氣時間短
blocks.en: Dry fog (<15 µm): droplets do not settle, action is mainly through the vapor phase, and aeration time is short

blocks.zh: Wet fog（>15–20 µm）：液滴沉降附著，液相 + 蒸氣相雙重作用
blocks.en: Wet fog (>15–20 µm): droplets settle and adhere to surfaces, so both liquid and vapor phases act

blocks.zh: 風險：噴嘴附近物件可能過度濕潤
blocks.en: Risk: items close to the nozzle may become over-wetted

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務重點：材質相容性評估不可省
blocks.en: CDMO practice point: material compatibility assessment cannot be skipped

blocks.zh: VHP 具強氧化性，選定除汙劑後，必須確認隔離器內所有材質（橡膠手套、不銹鋼、塑膠件、電子元件）的相容性。如果因腐蝕導致隔離器元件降解，不只是設備問題，更是產品汙染風險。
blocks.en: VHP is strongly oxidizing, so once the decontaminating agent is selected, you must confirm the compatibility of all materials inside the isolator (rubber gloves, stainless steel, plastic parts, electronic components). If corrosion degrades isolator components, it is not just an equipment problem but a product contamination risk.

blocks.zh: 監管視角：沒有通用標準，但需要完整驗證
blocks.en: Regulatory view: no universal standard, but full validation is required

blocks.zh: PDA 明確指出，目前業界沒有統一的 VHP 機械設計或分佈系統標準（no industrial standard）。這意味著監管機構（FDA、EMA）期待每個廠自行建立並驗證其使用的系統——你的驗證文件本身就是你的「標準」。
blocks.en: PDA states clearly that there is currently no industrial standard for VHP mechanical design or distribution systems. This means regulators (FDA, EMA) expect each site to establish and validate the system it uses; your validation documentation is itself your "standard."

blocks.zh: Q7-3  |  Empty Isolator Mapping of Temperature and Humidity Q7-3 | 空雔離器的溫濕度分佈量測
blocks.en: Q7-3 | Empty Isolator Mapping of Temperature and Humidity

blocks.zh: 為什麼要先做空腔 mapping？
blocks.en: Why map the empty isolator first?

blocks.zh: Mapping 的邏輯是：先了解空腔環境的溫濕度分布，才能預測 VHP 凝結量在哪裡多、在哪裡少。
blocks.en: The logic of mapping is: first understand the temperature and humidity distribution in the empty chamber, so you can predict where VHP condensation will be higher and where it will be lower.

blocks.zh: 如果某個角落比其他區域溫度低 2°C，VHP 就容易在那裡過度凝結，形成液滴——液相 VHP 雖然殺孢子力強，但過多時會延長曝氣時間，甚至傷害材質。反之，溫度較高的熱點，VHP 蒸氣不易凝結，殺孢子效果可能不足。
blocks.en: If one corner is 2°C cooler than the rest, VHP will tend to over-condense there and form droplets. Liquid-phase VHP is strongly sporicidal, but too much of it prolongs aeration time and can even damage materials. Conversely, at hotter spots VHP vapor condenses less readily and sporicidal efficacy may be insufficient.

blocks.zh: 比喻：溫度 mapping 就像畫天氣地圖
blocks.en: Analogy: temperature mapping is like drawing a weather map

blocks.zh: 你不能假設整個隔離器內部溫度均一，就像你不能假設整棟廠房的溫度一樣。必須先「量」才能知道哪裡是高壓（熱點）、哪裡是低壓（冷點），然後把 biological indicator（BI）放在最難殺到的地方——也就是「最差條件」位置。
blocks.en: You cannot assume the temperature is uniform throughout the isolator, just as you cannot assume it is uniform across an entire facility. You must measure first to learn where the highs (hot spots) and lows (cold spots) are, and then place the biological indicators (BIs) in the hardest-to-kill locations, that is, the worst-case positions.

blocks.zh: 重點：空腔 mapping ≠ 最終 mapping
blocks.en: Key point: empty-chamber mapping is not the final mapping

blocks.zh: PDA 說得很清楚：空腔 mapping 只是起點，最終的資格確認必須在負載條件（loaded conditions）下進行。原因是：
blocks.en: PDA is clear that empty-chamber mapping is only a starting point; final qualification must be performed under loaded conditions. The reasons are:

blocks.zh: 不銹鋼零件的熱容量高（heat sink），會讓周圍局部溫度下降
blocks.en: Stainless steel parts have high heat capacity (heat sink) and lower the local temperature around them

blocks.zh: 物件遮蔽了氣流，改變 VHP 分布
blocks.en: Objects block airflow and change the VHP distribution

blocks.zh: 從冷藏取出的瓶子（如直接從冷凍庫）會帶入冷點
blocks.en: Vials taken from cold storage (for example, straight from a freezer) bring in cold spots

blocks.zh: 空腔 mapping 的價值在於識別「固有熱點/冷點」，讓你知道應該把 thermocouple 和 BI 放在哪裡。
blocks.en: The value of empty-chamber mapping is in identifying the inherent hot and cold spots, so you know where to place thermocouples and BIs.

blocks.zh: 工具選擇：紅外線相機的局限性
blocks.en: Tool selection: limitations of infrared cameras

blocks.zh: PDA 提到可以用紅外線相機（IR camera）做初步掃描，但有個陷阱：不銹鋼表面反射率高，IR 讀值不準確。因此 IR 只能用於初步識別，最終仍需熱電偶（thermocouple）做精確量測。此外，現有的冷點可能遮蓋後方的熱點——所以不能只靠一次掃描就下定論。
blocks.en: PDA mentions that an infrared (IR) camera can be used for preliminary scanning, but there is a pitfall: stainless steel surfaces are highly reflective, so IR readings are inaccurate. IR should therefore be used only for initial identification, and precise measurement still requires thermocouples. In addition, an existing cold spot can mask a hot spot behind it, so you cannot draw conclusions from a single scan.

blocks.zh: 濕度 mapping 的必要性
blocks.en: Why humidity mapping is necessary

blocks.zh: VHP 的汽液平衡除了受溫度影響，也受相對濕度（RH）影響。如果隔離器內有吸濕性材質（如某些塑膠或聚合物零件），局部濕度會改變，進而影響 VHP 的凝結行為。因此，當材質多樣性高時，濕度 mapping 不能省略。
blocks.en: The vapor-liquid equilibrium of VHP is affected not only by temperature but also by relative humidity (RH). If the isolator contains hygroscopic materials (such as certain plastic or polymer parts), local humidity will change, which in turn affects VHP condensation behavior. When material diversity is high, humidity mapping therefore cannot be omitted.

blocks.zh: 你的隔離器連接著一台凍乾機（lyophilizer），其外壁在除汙過程中會散熱。這對隔離器的 temperature mapping 有什麼影響？你會在哪裡放 thermocouple？
blocks.en: Your isolator is connected to a lyophilizer whose outer wall gives off heat during decontamination. How does this affect temperature mapping of the isolator, and where would you place thermocouples?

blocks.zh: Q7-4  |  Conditions and Configurations During Decontamination Cycle Development Q7-4 | 去污循環開發期間的條件與配置
blocks.en: Q7-4 | Conditions and Configurations During Decontamination Cycle Development

blocks.zh: 「最差條件」的邏輯
blocks.en: The logic of "worst case"

blocks.zh: 除汙週期開發的核心問題是：「最難被殺到的孢子在哪裡？」 這個問題的答案就是你 BI 的放置位置，也是你「worst-case」負載配置的設計依據。
blocks.en: The core question in decontamination cycle development is: "Where is the hardest place to kill spores?" The answer is where you place your BIs, and it is also the basis for designing your worst-case load configuration.

blocks.zh: 如果你在最差條件下能達到目標 spore log reduction（通常 ≥6-log），那麼在所有較佳條件下也一定能達到。這是驗證策略的核心邏輯。
blocks.en: If you can achieve the target spore log reduction (usually ≥6-log) under worst-case conditions, you will also achieve it under every better condition. This is the core logic of the validation strategy.

blocks.zh: 比喻：最差條件就像壓力測試
blocks.en: Analogy: worst case is like a stress test

blocks.zh: 銀行壓力測試不是在「正常市場」下測，而是在「最糟市場條件」下測。除汙週期驗證也一樣——你要在「最擠、最遮蔽、最難到達的負載配置」下放 BI，才能證明你的週期是真的強健（robust），而不是只在空腔或輕負載時才有效。
blocks.en: A bank stress test is not run under "normal markets" but under the worst market conditions. Decontamination cycle validation works the same way: you place BIs in the most crowded, most shadowed, hardest-to-reach load configuration to show the cycle is truly robust, and not effective only in an empty chamber or a light load.

blocks.zh: 遮蔽表面（Occluded Surfaces）：最常見的失敗原因
blocks.en: Occluded surfaces: the most common cause of failure

blocks.zh: 實務上，除汙失敗最常見的原因就是「遮蔽」——VHP 氣體無法接觸到的表面。常見的遮蔽情況：
blocks.en: In practice, the most common cause of decontamination failure is occlusion: surfaces the VHP gas cannot reach. Typical occlusion situations include:

blocks.zh: 零件緊靠在一起，接觸面無法接觸 VHP
blocks.en: Parts pressed tightly together so that contact surfaces cannot be reached by VHP

blocks.zh: 手套摺疊或捲曲，內表面無法曝露
blocks.en: Gloves folded or rolled so that the inner surface is not exposed

blocks.zh: 包材折疊後形成密閉空間
blocks.en: Packaging material that folds into a sealed space

blocks.zh: 大型不銹鋼零件背面（陰影區）
blocks.en: The back (shadow area) of large stainless steel parts

blocks.zh: 因此，負載配置規格（load configuration specification）必須固定並文件化——任何改變都需要重新評估是否影響 VHP 分布。
blocks.en: The load configuration specification must therefore be fixed and documented, and any change requires re-evaluation of whether it affects VHP distribution.

blocks.zh: 油脂、指紋、矽油：除汙的隱形殺手
blocks.en: Oil, grease, fingerprints, silicone: the hidden killers of decontamination

blocks.zh: PDA 特別提到 oil、grease、fingerprints、silicone 等表面汙染物，這些物質會在孢子和 VHP 之間形成物理屏障，大幅降低殺孢子效果。這就回應了 Q7-1 的清潔邏輯——在除汙前，所有表面必須清潔乾淨，尤其是手工操作時觸碰到的表面。
blocks.en: PDA specifically mentions surface contaminants such as oil, grease, fingerprints and silicone. These form a physical barrier between spores and VHP and greatly reduce sporicidal efficacy. This echoes the cleaning logic of Q7-1: before decontamination, all surfaces must be thoroughly cleaned, especially those touched during manual operations.

blocks.zh: 參考文件：PDA TR34 & TR51
blocks.en: Reference documents: PDA TR34 & TR51

blocks.zh: PDA 在這裡引用了兩份技術報告：
blocks.en: PDA cites two technical reports here:

blocks.zh: TR34：隔離器系統設計與驗證——負載條件的詳細考量
blocks.en: TR34: isolator system design and validation, with detailed considerations on load conditions

blocks.zh: TR51：生物指示劑（BI）的製造與使用——BI 本身的品質變異會影響驗證數據的準確性
blocks.en: TR51: manufacture and use of biological indicators (BIs); variability in the quality of the BI itself affects the accuracy of validation data

blocks.zh: 換言之：驗證數據的可靠性，不只取決於除汙週期，也取決於你用的 BI 品質是否一致。
blocks.en: In other words, the reliability of validation data depends not only on the decontamination cycle but also on the consistency of the quality of the BIs you use.

blocks.zh: 如果你的負載配置在生產中需要依批次調整（例如不同規格的零件組合），這對除汙週期驗證策略意味著什麼？你會設計幾個 worst-case 配置？
blocks.en: If your load configuration has to be adjusted from batch to batch in production (for example, different combinations of parts for different formats), what does this mean for the decontamination cycle validation strategy? How many worst-case configurations would you design?

blocks.zh: 本節重點總結 Section Summary — Topic 7a: Decontamination Basics (Q7-1 to Q7-4)
blocks.en: Section Summary — Topic 7a: Decontamination Basics (Q7-1 to Q7-4)

blocks.zh: 清潔在先，VHP 在後（Q7-1）：VHP 無法穿透殘留物與油脂，清潔步驟是除汙效果的前提。多產品隔離器需特別評估前一批產品的毒性與殘留風險，並管制 hold time。
blocks.en: Cleaning first, VHP second (Q7-1): VHP cannot penetrate residues and grease, so cleaning is a prerequisite for effective decontamination. Multiproduct isolators require specific assessment of the toxicity and residue risk of the previous batch, and hold times must be controlled.

blocks.zh: VHP 是業界主流，但沒有通用標準（Q7-2）：熱板蒸發與霧化是兩種主要 VHP 產生方式，各有其操作風險。VHP 的兩相平衡特性使製程控制複雜，每個廠必須自行建立並驗證其系統。
blocks.en: VHP is the industry mainstream, but there is no universal standard (Q7-2): flash vaporization and fogging are the two main ways to generate VHP, each with its own operating risks. The two-phase nature of VHP makes process control complex, and each site must establish and validate its own system.

blocks.zh: 溫濕度 mapping 是週期資格確認的必要步驟（Q7-3）：空腔 mapping 識別固有熱點/冷點；負載 mapping 才是最終標準。外接設備（凍乾機、高壓滅菌釜）與低溫物料都會影響隔離器內部的溫度分布。
blocks.en: Temperature and humidity mapping is a required step in cycle qualification (Q7-3): empty-chamber mapping identifies the inherent hot and cold spots; loaded mapping is the final standard. Connected equipment (lyophilizers, autoclaves) and low-temperature materials both affect the temperature distribution inside the isolator.

blocks.zh: 最差條件負載驗證（Q7-4）：遮蔽表面（occluded surfaces）是除汙失敗最常見原因。負載配置必須固定並文件化，任何改變都需重新評估。油脂、指紋等表面汙染物會干擾 VHP 效果，再次強調清潔的關鍵性。
blocks.en: Worst-case load validation (Q7-4): occluded surfaces are the most common cause of decontamination failure. The load configuration must be fixed and documented, and any change requires re-evaluation. Surface contaminants such as grease and fingerprints interfere with VHP efficacy, which again underlines the importance of cleaning.

blocks.zh: 整合視角：清潔 → 消毒（bioburden 降低）→ 溫濕度 mapping → 最差條件負載驗證 → VHP 週期——這是一條環環相扣的驗證鏈，任一環節薄弱都會影響最終的無菌保證。
blocks.en: Integrated view: cleaning → disinfection (bioburden reduction) → temperature and humidity mapping → worst-case load validation → VHP cycle. This is a closely linked validation chain, and weakness at any link affects the final sterility assurance.
